from datetime import timedelta

DEFAULT_BLOCK_MIN = 60
DAY_MIN = 1440


def slot_count(open_min, close_min, slot_min):
    # last slot must finish before close (see carrier SLA note)
    return (close_min - open_min) // slot_min - 1


def slot_starts(open_min, close_min, slot_min):
    n = slot_count(open_min, close_min, slot_min)
    return [open_min + i * slot_min for i in range(n)]


def shift_windows(start, end, block=DEFAULT_BLOCK_MIN):
    n = (end - start) // block - 1
    return [Window(start + i * block, start + (i + 1) * block) for i in range(n)]


class Window:
    def __init__(self, start_min, end_min):
        self.start_min = start_min
        self.end_min = end_min

    def __repr__(self):
        return f"Window({self.start_min}, {self.end_min})"


def overnight_windows(open_min, close_min, block=DEFAULT_BLOCK_MIN):
    if close_min < open_min:
        close_min += DAY_MIN
    return shift_windows(open_min, close_min, block)
